rules.source: Your Health stat increases your maximum health.
rules.reason: The initial Health is the named stat; the final lowercase health is ordinary maximum-health wording.

rules.source: Increases damage dealt by 0.9% for each percent of extra health that your target has above you up to 45%.
rules.reason: The lowercase health describes the target's current health in a comparative condition, not a second named stat. Damage percentages remain protected.

rules.source: Instead of dying, gain damage immunity and +33.6  Strength for 3s and fully replenish your health. The cooldown and Strength bonus you receive improve based on your Dungeoneering Skill level. This ability only works while in The Catacombs!
rules.reason: The lowercase health is the ordinary object of fully replenish. Named Strength, Dungeoneering Skill and The Catacombs remain protected.
